_: The first ten minutes in the view (--opening=v2; docs/review/first-ten-minutes-plan.md). Tune here, not in code. The Hand speaks each prompt once, in the first reign only (Against the Storm's envoy; Six Ages: teach a few things). storybook: the storybook's pages kept in the v2 opening (by their painting's name); storyKeys: whether its pages show key strips (off: the game decides). crowning: the King's first moment (crowning.gd): on, the line and the one under it, seconds it holds, how high on the screen, the royal standard's height and seconds to rise. tracker: the date card's one goal until the first winter (on, its words, %d the seasons to go). hideUntilWinter: the toolbar keys at rest, hidden in the first reign until the first winter (UI v2; their keys still work).
speaker: The Hand

prompts.text: The realm is yours, Your Grace. The court is waiting.
A lord asks for you. Follow the gold arrow.
Hold the realm whole to the first winter.
A house turns from you. The court will let you answer.
Winter, and the realm stands. History is watching.
